reason: The repository describes a DeepSeek Harness companion focused on account monitoring and reminders: it tracks balance and per-conversation token/cost usage, shows a compact panel for quick wallet/session actions, and issues completion/low-balance alerts with fallback behavior. It also supports multi-account switching and optional host-gated session controls, which confirms a user-facing role of notification-driven monitoring and session management rather than development automation or content generation.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中监控账户余额与会话用量，并在需要时提供低余额及会话完成提醒，同时提供可视化钱包与会话控制入口。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a DeepSeek Harness wallet companion that monitors account balance and per-session token/cost usage, with optional completion and low-balance reminders plus quick session/account controls.

capabilities: Query external official balance and pricing-related endpoints
Track per-session token and cost usage from runtime events
Store and read plugin preferences/settings in browser-compatible local storage
Display floating/portable wallet UI with session panel controls
Show completion and low-balance reminders with notification fallback
Read and switch active DeepSeek API key for billing context
Open official recharge page in external browser context
Invoke host-provided session actions when host advertises capability
